name: quick-swap-tools
description: Low-latency global controls for Whatnot seller streams in Firefox
author: OniByts

scripts.build:extension: rm -rf dist/unsigned && web-ext build --source-dir extension --artifacts-dir dist/unsigned --overwrite-dest
scripts.test: npm run build:native && node --test tests/*.test.js && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_*.py' -v
scripts.check: npm run lint:extension && npm run test && python3 -m py_compile native/quick_swap.py tests/test_native.py tests/test_native_host.py tests/test_release_installer.py
